propositions: Canonical preview/sync routes must emit only exit codes 0/1/2 with 0 for benign/paused/no-work states, 1 for operational failure, 2 for invalid invocation/configuration

Legacy reconcile CLI and direct-engine routes must translate the same internal disposition to historical exit codes 3/4/75 with original messages and defaults for workflow/systemd/Jenkins/script compatibility
Both canonical and legacy adapters consume one shared typed disposition object and execute the pass once without divergent result processing or retry logic
Production workflow at .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml must use canonical 0/1/2 contract with no legacy numeric whitelist while preserving paused-state commit-skip behavior
Documentation must publish both canonical 0/1/2 and retained legacy 3/4/75 contracts with rolling-migration guarantee for existing checked-out workflows
No production automation, systemd units, Jenkins files, or probes consume legacy 3/4/75 exit codes outside compatibility-only code paths and tests
